'''Pack trackers''' were individuals employed at the [[Kuat Passenger Port]] to transport passenger luggage by using [[Repulsorcart/Legends|repulsorcarts]]. [[Benni]] was one of the innumerable pack trackers that plied their trade on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]].
